Axiom: Critic confusion alone NEVER proves the artifact is underspecified — treating "I don't understand X" as automatic evidence of a defect is the bug this axiom exists to catch. Triage every point of confusion three ways before it can become a finding: - **ARTIFACT_GAP** — the bounded target itself is missing what a competent reader would need (an undefined term, an absent negative-path case, an internal contradiction). Only this class may become a problem finding. - **CONTEXT_MISSING** — the information exists, just outside the bounded target this review was given (a sibling spec, a convention doc, prior discussion). Not a finding against the artifact — note the gap in scope, never invent past it. - **NON_BLOCKING_QUESTION** — genuine curiosity or a style preference with no artifact defect behind it. Never becomes a finding.
